title: Hip-hop Halloween weekend in Miami and Fort Lauderdale
igCaption:
Halloween weekend has options, so check the traffic before you go. Oct. 30 to Nov. 1, Miami and Fort Lauderdale

Sources: WSVN 7News, Miami New Times, Sun Sentinel, Eventbrite

#MiamiEvents #FortLauderdale #HalloweenMiami #HipHop

scenes.text: Looking for Halloween plans this weekend? Start with Wynwood and Brickell, then check the traffic.
Miami Police warned drivers on Friday, October thirtieth, to expect road closures, parking restrictions, and heavier pedestrian traffic for Halloween celebrations this weekend.
scenes.caption: Miami Police warned drivers on Friday, Oct. 30, to expect road closures, parking restrictions, and heavier pedestrian traffic for Halloween celebrations this weekend.

scenes.text: For a Miami hip-hop tie-in, Yung Miami released Watch Dis. She celebrated it Thursday, October twenty-ninth, at Privé 954 Restaurant and Lounge with 103.5 The Beat.
scenes.caption: For a Miami hip-hop tie-in, Yung Miami released Watch Dis. She celebrated it Thursday, Oct. 29, at Privé 954 Restaurant & Lounge with 103.5 The Beat.

scenes.text: Fort Lauderdale has 18 night club music events on Eventbrite for this weekend. It also has Halloween house party listings if you want to keep scrolling. If you end up at one, open NEAR and spot who else showed.

scenes.text: If your weekend plans run into November, Broward County has Beer B Que Music Festival on the radar. Sun Sentinel included Kodak Black and Rick Ross in its can’t-miss November events list.
